Spec Hub | API Design and Governance | Postman API Platform
Skip to main content
Design & Build
Spec Hub
Design, standardize, and govern API specifications with multi-format
designer, built-in governance, and AI that knows your standards.
Get Started
Postman Spec Hub, showing the Payments API OpenAPI definition open in the editor beside the generated outline of its servers, tags, paths and components.
Trusted by teams at
Go from API design to delivery
Multi-format API design
Design REST, event-driven, GraphQL, gRPC, and Smithy APIs in one place.
All-in-one specification editor
Edit specs with the visual designer or code views, and preview live documentation as you work.
Built-in validation and governance
Set up governance rules, have a real-time view into API compliance with API Catalog, and automatically enforce standards with Postman CLI.
Design APIs faster with AI that knows your standards
Postman AI generates spec scaffolds, applies your governance rules, and writes endpoint descriptions so your team goes from just getting started to compliant API spec in minutes.
Ask Postman AI
Spec Hub allows us to consolidate our entire API workflow, from design to testing and documentation, into a single, seamless platform. This eliminates the need for constant imports and exports, keeping our teams in sync and accelerating our API development process.
"
Ben Heil
,
Principal Software Engineer
,
Paylocity
Read customer story →

Internal workspaces
Make your internal APIs discoverable, reusable, and secure. Choose to keep your workspace personal or share it with individuals and teams within your organization.
Partner workspaces
Provide partners and external developers with a secure space to collaborate and test APIs. Enable multi-partner mode to share the same workspace with multiple partners.

Run all API workflows with AI

Documents | Markdown in Your Workspace | Postman
Skip to main content
Computing is changing, so is Postman – Introducing Postman.ai
Learn more
→
Design & Build
Documents
Keep API knowledge in Markdown files beside the work it supports, available to your team and AI, and manageable with Git.
Get Started
Read Docs
The Orders API workspace in Postman with the Orders-API-README Document open and Postman AI answering “What can the orders api do?” beside it — collection nav, a rich-text README with a Bash quick-start, and the agent rail returning a Core-endpoints table.
Trusted by teams at
Shared context for teams and AI
Efficient for people and AI
The Postman editor offers pretty or raw editing and renders visually for people, while Markdown stays efficient for AI to write and consume.
Version controlled with Git
With Native Git, Documents live alongside your code, so you manage them with the Git workflows you already use.
Access controlled by your workspace
Documents follow your workspace roles and permissions, so the right people can read and edit them.
Move API work faster with AI that has your context
Documents give Postman AI durable context about how your API team works. It can use this context throughout your API work from design to distribution, and also capture plans and results for your team to review.
Ask Postman AI

Mock Servers | Postman API Platform
Skip to main content
Computing is changing, so is Postman – Introducing Postman.ai
Learn more
→
Design & Build
Mock Servers
Don't let APIs you don't own slow you down. Write stateful mocks in code, then deploy them as stable mock servers your teams and pipelines can depend on.
Get Started
Read Docs
Postman Mock Servers, showing a mock's authentication endpoints beside the request-handling code that returns their mocked responses.
Trusted by teams at
Write the behavior in code, Postman runs it as a stable server
Start from what you have
Create a mock from a specification or a collection, or point Postman AI at your codebase to write one.
Code in your repo
Each mock is a JavaScript file of request handlers in your repo, so it behaves as a real service.
Your team's own URL
Deploy to a URL on your team's subdomain, and it stays the same even with mock updates.
State per session
Data persists between requests, and each session gets its own copy, so parallel runs stay clean.
Turn your API context into a working mock with AI
Postman AI can write and update mock code using your spec, collection, or codebase as context. Describe the behavior you want and it generates a working mock.
Ask Postman AI
Mock servers removed development dependencies. Postman allows API development, testing and releases to be run in parallel. There's no waiting for API implementation to be completed.
"
Eduardo Iriarte-Mendez
,
Senior Software Engineer
,
Flix
Read customer story →
RESOURCES
Go deeper on programmable mocks and simulations
Build programmable mocks
Create a mock from a specification or collection, add dynamic behavior and state, and run it locally or in the cloud.
Read docs
→
Run simulations in CI
Use the Postman CLI to run tests against simulated dependencies as part of your CI/CD workflow.
Read docs
→
Test failure conditions with simulations
Configure repeatable delays, rate limits, errors, and failure conditions to validate retries, fallbacks, and recovery.
Read docs
→
Talk to a Postman expert
See where API dependencies block your teams, and how to standardize programmable mocks across local development, CI, and shared testing.
For AI agents: the clean markdown version of this page is available at https://www.postman.com/product/mock-servers.md
